description:
Publish media that already exists, with no generation and no charge. from_file: a local video (.mp4 or .mov) is published now. create_upload → complete_upload → publish_upload: a signed upload, video or JPEG/PNG (PUT straight to storage, never via this server; expires in 15 min), published now; publishing consumes it. publish_existing: a finished generated video (taskId), a completed upload (uploadId) or a local image (imagePath), to every network of its accounts in one call (images: instagram/bluesky/linkedin/threads/facebook/pinterest), with mode asap (now) or scheduled (once, at publishAt). YouTube needs title, description, tags and privacyStatus; Rumble and Fanvue title and description; the other networks a caption (publish_existing uses description). If a call times out, retry with the same idempotencyKey: the original result is replayed. A result with errorCode publish_unknown must NOT be retried: the post may be live, check the account first.
Actions and their required fields: from_file (provider, videoPath, accountIds); create_upload (contentType, sizeBytes); complete_upload (uploadId); publish_upload (provider, uploadId, accountIds); publish_existing (mediaKind, title, description, mode).

accountIds.description: Target accounts: the IDs from accounts (action: list) (channel IDs for YouTube, IG user IDs for Instagram, DIDs for Bluesky, member IDs or org URNs for LinkedIn, user IDs for Threads, Page IDs for Facebook, user IDs for Pinterest, Fanvue account IDs, Hive usernames for 3Speak, Channel IDs for Rumble).

accounts.description: Accounts to publish to, each an account name or id from accounts (action: list); the network is read from the account, so one call can reach several networks. Omit to use the persona's bound publishing accounts.

action.description: What to do: from_file | create_upload | complete_upload | publish_upload | publish_existing. The description lists the fields each action needs.

boardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to publish the pin to (the id from accounts (action: list_boards)). Required for pinterest.

caption.description: Instagram/Bluesky/LinkedIn/Threads/Facebook/3Speak: required caption. Pinterest: used as the pin description when description is omitted.

contentType.description: The real type: video/mp4 (.mp4), video/quicktime (.mov), image/jpeg or image/png. The server verifies the bytes at completion.

description.description: YouTube/Rumble/Fanvue: required video description. Pinterest: pin description (optional; caption is used when omitted).

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key: if the call times out or fails ambiguously, retry with the SAME key — the server returns the original publish result instead of posting the video again. Omitted: a key is generated per call.

imagePath.description: mediaKind image: local path of the JPEG or PNG (max 8 MB).

mediaKind.description: task = a finished generated video (taskId); upload = a completed signed upload, video or image (uploadId); image = a local JPEG/PNG (imagePath).

mode.description: Required. 'asap' publishes now; 'scheduled' publishes once at publishAt.

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

provider.description: The social platform to publish the video to.

publishAt.description: mode scheduled: when to publish, 3h-30d ahead. Wall-clock in timezone (e.g. "2026-12-01T20:00:00"), or with an offset.

sizeBytes.description: Exact size in bytes (max 2GB video, 8 MB image).

tags.description: YouTube only: required list of tags.

taskId.description: mediaKind task: the task id of the finished video.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a publishAt without an offset. Defaults to UTC.

title.description: YouTube/Rumble/Fanvue: required video title. Pinterest: pin title (optional).

uploadId.description: The uploadId returned by publish_video (action: create_upload), after the bytes were PUT to its signedUrl.

videoPath.description: Local path to the video file (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB). The video is published as-is: no generation, no schedule.

name: publish_video
